name: Plaza Los Encinos Tecate
summary: Plaza Los Encinos Tecate is a well-regarded community shopping center in Tecate, Baja California, serving both local residents and cross-border shoppers. With over 1,000 positive reviews and convenient daily hours, it offers a practical mix of retail and dining options for the border region.
demographics: Plaza Los Encinos Tecate serves a cross-border market drawing from both Tecate, Baja California and southern San Diego County communities. The primary visitor base consists of middle-income Mexican families and cross-border shoppers seeking retail variety and dining options. The trade area includes a mix of young families, working professionals, and retirees who value convenient access to both Mexican and international retail brands. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for one-stop convenience with grocery anchors, casual dining, and service-oriented tenants that cater to everyday household needs.
description: Plaza Los Encinos Tecate stands as a prominent shopping destination in the border city of Tecate, Baja California, serving both local residents and cross-border visitors from southern California. Located at 200 Encinos in the Loma Alta district, this community-oriented shopping center has established itself as a convenient retail hub for the region. With a solid 4.3-star rating from over 1,000 reviews, the plaza demonstrates consistent appeal to its diverse customer base. The center maintains welcoming operating hours from 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily, providing ample shopping time for families and working professionals alike. Its strategic location in Tecate, combined with accessible parking and a tenant mix designed for everyday convenience, makes Plaza Los Encinos a valued community gathering place that bridges the unique retail needs of the border region.
